select f.id as surveyOrgId,f.name as surveyOrgName, #{entrustOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as entrustOrgId,#{entrustOrgName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as entrustOrgName, #{beginDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as beginDate,#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as endDate, ifnull(t1.num1,0) as caseNum,ifnull(t2.num2,0) as longNum,ifnull(t3.num3,0) as vetoNum,ifnull(t4.num4,0) as commitEdNum, ifnull(t5.num5,0) as vetoCaseNum from survey_franchisee f left join ( select o.survey_org_id,o.survey_org_name,count(1) num1 from survey_assign_org o left join survey_risk_case_info i on o.survey_info_id = i.id left join survey_risk_case c on o.survey_id = c.id where o.delete_flag = 0
group by o.survey_org_id )t1 on f.id = t1.survey_org_id left join ( select o.survey_org_id,o.survey_org_name,count(1) num2 from survey_assign_org o left join survey_risk_case_info i on o.survey_info_id = i.id left join survey_risk_case c on o.survey_id = c.id where o.delete_flag = 0
and ((o.org_survey_state = 4 and DATE_FORMAT(o.report_date,'%Y-%m-%d') > DATE_FORMAT(o.org_end_time,'%Y-%m-%d')) or (o.org_survey_state != 4 and DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d') > DATE_FORMAT(o.org_end_time,'%Y-%m-%d'))) group by o.survey_org_id ) t2 on f.id = t2.survey_org_id left join ( select o.survey_org_id,o.survey_org_name,sum(o.return_state) num3 from survey_assign_org o left join survey_risk_case_info i on o.survey_info_id = i.id left join survey_risk_case c on o.survey_id = c.id where o.delete_flag = 0
group by o.survey_org_id ) t3 on f.id = t3.survey_org_id left join ( select o.survey_org_id,o.survey_org_name,count(1) num4 from survey_assign_org o left join survey_risk_case_info i on o.survey_info_id = i.id left join survey_risk_case c on o.survey_id = c.id where o.delete_flag = 0
and o.report_date is not null group by o.survey_org_id ) t4 on f.id = t4.survey_org_id left join ( select o.survey_org_id,o.survey_org_name,count(1) num5 from survey_assign_org o left join survey_risk_case_info i on o.survey_info_id = i.id left join survey_risk_case c on o.survey_id = c.id where o.delete_flag = 0
and o.return_state > 0 group by o.survey_org_id ) t5 on f.id = t5.survey_org_id where f.delete_flag = 0 and t1.num1 > 0
and find_in_set(f.id,#{surveyOrgIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
order by t1.num1 desc
limit #{pageIndex}, #{pageSize}
